Evidence/MFI-SPINE-2015-Q4
Evidence record

2015 Q4 microfinance observation with a portfolio contradiction

What does this evidence establish?

For microfinance programmes supported by the Social Fund for Development (SFD), the SFD source dated 31 December 2015 supports 93,118 active borrowers and 509,590 savers. Its portfolio value is contradictory within the source: the table reports YER 6.741 billion and the narrative text a value near YER 9 billion.

What does it measure?

Active borrowers, savers and outstanding loan portfolio (nominal Yemeni rials) reported for SFD-supported microfinance programmes at 31 December 2015.

Who or what does it apply to?

SFD-supported reporting programmes.

When was it measured or observed?

31 December 2015

How current is it?

The observation in this record is dated 31 December 2015. It should not be read as describing a later period.

What this evidence does not establish

It does not establish the 2015 Q4 portfolio value: the source's table (YER 6.741 billion) and its narrative (near YER 9 billion) disagree, so neither value is adopted and the series is not smoothed.

How was it produced?

Figures taken from the end-2015 publication of the Social Fund for Development (SFD), which contains a provider table and narrative text; where the two disagree, on the portfolio, both values are recorded and neither is adopted.
